units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:7">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> <he>כל ערי הכ׳</he> all the towns of the (Jordan) district.

Erub. VIII, 2; Kel. XVII, 11 מכ׳ בפונדיון וכ׳ bread for two meals consists of a loaf bought for a dupondium when four S’ah of wheat are worth one Sela; ib. משתי ידות לכ׳ וכ׳ of two thirds of a loaf three of which represent a Kab of grain.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 40:13">Sifré Deut. 40</cite> <he>כ׳ ומקל ירדו וכ׳</he> bread and stick (reward and punishment) came down from heaven tied together; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּכָּרִים</he>, <he>כִּכָּרוֹת</he>.

senses.gloss: Kikkar, a weight of silver or gold, talent (= 3000 Shekel, v. Zuckerm. Talm. Münz. p. 7).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 44a:14">Ab. Zar. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>שוה כִּכַּר זהב</he> worth a gold talent; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כִּכָּרִים</he>, constr. <he>כִּכְּרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 6:3:4">Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵇ</cite> top.
